aiDescriptions.n: AI_GENERATE_TABLE_DESC drafts table, view and column descriptions, optionally from sample data. The SQL path is GA since 2025-09-29. A Snowsight UI path also exists.

bulkMetadata.n: One ALTER TABLE ... ALTER (...) statement sets COMMENT on many columns. COMMENT ON handles one object. No file import tool exists.

autoClassify.n: A classification profile set on a database auto-classifies its tables (GA Aug 2025). Support for semi-structured data is GA since 2026-02-05.

sampleValues.n: Semantic views accept SAMPLE_VALUES and IS_ENUM on dimensions, in both YAML and DDL. The author writes the values. This setting does not auto-sample them.

queryHistory.n: Semantic View Autopilot uses query history visible to the creating role. It suggests relationships and verified queries. The page shows no preview label.

lineage.n: The Snowsight Lineage tab shows column lineage. GET_LINEAGE accepts the COLUMN domain. The default and maximum distance is 5. It needs Enterprise Edition or higher.

evals.n: Cortex Analyst evaluations run a semantic view against its verified queries and compare results. Snowflake now recommends Cortex Agents.

vendors.enrichHowTo: Call the AI_GENERATE_TABLE_DESC stored procedure on each table with describe_columns set to true. This drafts table and column descriptions. Review them. Then write the final text with ALTER TABLE ... ALTER (col COMMENT '...', ...), with many columns per statement.

aiDescriptions.n: Catalog Explorer has AI-generated comments for catalogs, schemas, tables, views, columns and more. It is GA since 2024-06-27. Databricks advises review. Saving runs ALTER, which can disrupt jobs.

bulkMetadata.n: One ALTER TABLE ... ALTER COLUMN statement can set COMMENT on several columns (Runtime 16.3 and above). SET TAGS also works. No file import tool exists.

autoClassify.n: Data Classification is GA since 2026-04-20. It is an agentic AI system that tags sensitive data. Scanning views is Beta (2026-09-15). Auto-tag configuration in the API is Public Preview.

sampleValues.n: Genie format assistance samples representative values. Entity matching keeps up to 1,024 values per column, for up to 120 columns. Row filters exclude the table.

queryHistory.n: When you add tables, Genie searches popular workspace queries that you can view. It suggests them as example queries. You accept or reject each one.

lineage.n: The system.access.column_lineage table has a rolling 1-year window. It records only when the system can infer lineage.

evals.n: Genie benchmarks allow up to 500 questions per agent. Reference SQL scores them. An Evaluations tab tracks runs. The page shows no preview label.

vendors.enrichHowTo: Generate comments in Catalog Explorer with AI-generated comments. Review each one. Then save. For scripted writes, run ALTER TABLE ... ALTER COLUMN with several COMMENT clauses in one statement. Then add a Genie benchmark set. Re-run it after each metadata change.

Test and monitor a Genie Agent

aiDescriptions.n: Data insights drafts table and column descriptions with Gemini. Generate without publishing has no preview label. Publishing to Knowledge Catalog is Preview.

bulkMetadata.n: ALTER TABLE ... ALTER COLUMN ... SET OPTIONS (description=...) sets a column description. It covers tables and views. It sets one column per statement, so script it.

autoClassify.n: Sensitive Data Protection discovery profiles BigQuery (GA). It can auto-attach sensitivity tags. It is a separate product from BigQuery.

sampleValues.n: Agents can match terms to values with existing embeddings of your column values (for example Texas to TX). You must create the embeddings.

queryHistory.n: The docs show no query-history mining for agent context. Teams add verified queries (formerly golden queries), glossaries and instructions by hand.

lineage.n: Column-level lineage for BigQuery jobs is GA since 2025-09-29, in Knowledge Catalog. Custom sources support table level only.

evals.n: The docs show no eval runner. Verified queries guide the agent. The chat shows the reasoning of the agent for each answer.

vendors.enrichHowTo: Run data insights on a table to draft table and column descriptions. Edit them and publish. For scripted writes, run ALTER TABLE ... ALTER COLUMN ... SET OPTIONS (description=...) per column. Then add verified queries and glossary terms to the data agent.

aiDescriptions.n: Gemini LookML assistant (Preview) writes dimensions, dimension groups and measures. The docs do not describe field description or label generation.

bulkMetadata.n: Descriptions, labels and synonyms are LookML text in project files. Bulk edits need scripted file changes and Git. No metadata import API exists.

autoClassify.n: The Looker docs show no classification feature. Teams classify in the warehouse, for example with BigQuery Sensitive Data Protection.

sampleValues.n: Conversational Analytics can sample field values and fuzzy search them to pick filter values. Conversational Analytics API is GA since 2026-06-23.

queryHistory.n: The docs do not describe query-history mining for LookML or verified queries. System Activity only reports usage.

lineage.n: Knowledge Catalog lineage for Looker (Google Cloud core) is Preview. It is object level only. Looker does not support column-level lineage.

evals.n: The docs show no eval runner. Verified queries (golden queries) serve as examples. Pivots and custom fields are unsupported. Admins can review user feedback (Preview).

vendors.enrichHowTo: Write description, label and synonyms parameters on LookML fields. Keep text short and in business words. Hide internal ID fields. Commit the files through the Looker IDE and Git. Add verified queries to the conversational analytics agent as examples.

notes.text: Release notes show GA on 2026-04-20. Scanning views reached Beta on 2026-09-15. The API went GA on 2026-10-14. Auto-tag configuration in the API remains Public Preview.
On Runtime 16.3 and above, ALTER TABLE ... ALTER COLUMN accepts several column changes in one statement. Commas separate the changes.
Genie Spaces are now called Genie Agents. The docs moved to the genie-agents path. The Benchmarks and value sampling pages carry no status label.
ALTER COLUMN SET OPTIONS (description=...) is documented for tables and views. Column-level lineage for BigQuery jobs went GA on 2025-09-29.
Dataplex Universal Catalog is now called Knowledge Catalog. Conversational Analytics API is GA for BigQuery and Looker as of 2026-06-23. Verified queries were formerly golden queries.
Semantic view YAML and DDL support SAMPLE_VALUES and IS_ENUM. IS_ENUM marks the listed values as the full set. IS_ENUM is valid on dimensions only.

sources.t: YAML vs DDL authoring for semantic views

notes.text: Looker does not offer AI descriptions, auto classification, query history, column lineage or evals natively. The Looker docs support this. Descriptions are written as LookML.
